description: Intentional cross-model option differences for the workbook editor's Review tab compare view (Phase 3) and, later, the cross-model copy-parity test (consistency review 2026-06-11 rec 7). Each entry names an option (option_id, or rpo where option_id is not a reliable join key), the diverging field ('*' = all compared fields), the model(s) whose divergence is vouched for, a business reason, and a status. status=intentional suppresses the divergence in the compare view (still visible behind the 'show intentional' toggle) once every deviating model is covered by 'models'; status=pending-review only annotates — the row stays flagged until a product decision lands (review §6 R-items).

entries.reason: ZZ3 includes-list drops '(BC7) Black LS6 engine cover' on Z06, ZR1, and ZR1X — BC7 does not exist on those models' different engines. Review §5.
WUB is Z06 standard equipment (sec_stan_001) vs a selectable exhaust option on Stingray/Grand Sport (sec_exha_001). Review §5.
GS/Z06 copy is applicability-accurate ('Front and rear on Grand Sport, Z06, ZR1 and ZR1X models'); Stingray keeps generic copy. Review §5.
Z06 gets its own logo floor mat ('Z06 logo') vs car-silhouette copy on other models — GM applicability split. Suppresses only once Stingray's separate style drift (C-2/C-4) converges. Review §5.

Z06 EYT description referencing 'Z06 on side quarter' is model-specific emblem content. Does not cover the truncated GS description (C-1 blocker) — the row stays flagged until C-1 is fixed. Review §5.
R-1: UV6 Head-Up Display sits in sec_1lte_001 on Z06 vs sec_2lte_001 on SR/GS — could be genuine (HUD standard from 1LZ) or a mis-sectioned row. Verify against the Z06 order guide.
R-2: SC7 roof panel storage pouch is LPO interior (sec_lpoi_001) on Stingray vs LPO exterior (sec_lpoe_001) on GS/Z06 — intended catalog placement unknown.
R-3: DRZ name/description content is swapped between Stingray and GS/Z06, not just restyled — pick one canonical pair before the C-2 copy-convergence pass.
R-4: GS/Z06 long EFR copy references CFV/CFZ ground effects that don't exist on Stingray — SR's short copy may be intentionally model-correct; not a simple majority-wins overwrite.
R-4: GS/Z06 long EDU copy references CFV/CFZ ground effects that don't exist on Stingray — SR's short copy may be intentionally model-correct; not a simple majority-wins overwrite.
R-5: Z06 NGA is quad-center exit, so dropping 'Corner Exit' looks deliberate — but each model's description should state its exit style explicitly; currently Z06 says nothing.
R-6: per-trim seat rows — whether trim grouping (Stingray's sec_*lte sections) or seat grouping (sec_seat_002) wins is a presentation decision.
